question: Who among the following was the first Indian actor to be made a Chevalier of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sivaji Ganeshan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sivaji Ganesan** as the first Indian actor to be made a** Chevalier of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres in 1995.**
 
• His full name was **Villupuram Chinnaiya Manrayar Ganesamoorthy, **popularly known as **Sivaji Ganesan.**
 
• He was a south Indian actor and acted in **Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Hindi **movies. 
 
• He worked for **5 decades in the Indian film industry and acted in 288 films**.
 
• In** 1997 he won the highest film honour** in Indian cinema **Dada Saheb Falke award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He received many prestigious awards like **Padam Shri in 1966, the Filmfare award, National Film Award, and NTR National Award.**
 
• The** Chevalier of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres** which means** ****Order of the Arts and the Letters **is one of the highest French Honours given by the **Ministry of Culture.**
 
• It is given for the** outstanding contribution to the field of arts and literature.**
 
• **Soumitra Chatterjee **was also honoured with this award in** 1999 for their contribution to Indian Cinema.**
